battle.name: 英蘇入侵伊朗
battle.brief: 英蘇入侵伊朗是第二次世界大戰期間的軍事行動；英國與蘇聯於1941年8月依協議進入伊朗，向德黑蘭與北部地區推進，迫使伊朗國王退位。條目選列的真實裝備是法國於1840年列裝的Percussion rifle；其正式型號歸屬前裝步槍類，並作為本條唯一的裝備說明。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: Percussion rifle在法國早期陸軍步槍體系中屬前裝步槍類，位於地面部隊的標準槍械索引，並作為本條唯一的陸軍裝備資料項。

countries: 這場戰役於1941年8月25日由英國與蘇聯對伊朗帝國發動，至9月16日禮薩・沙退位，主要軍事階段告一段落。英方並非只由英格蘭部隊作戰，而是由英軍中東司令部統籌，實際地面骨幹為英軍第4印度師與第18步兵旅，配屬皇家空軍、皇家海軍，以及由印度與伊拉克調來的運輸、兵站及工兵單位。蘇方由外高加索軍區指揮，作戰主力是紅軍第39軍，另有裏海艦隊與航空兵支援，地面部隊從亞塞拜然蘇維埃共和國南部越境進入伊朗北部。伊朗以帝國陸軍應戰，在西北與北部邊境部署多個師級單位，德黑蘭則由中央直屬部隊接應。英軍從伊拉克沿Khanaqin、Qasr-e Shirin一帶進入伊朗，第18旅同時在波斯灣的Bandar Abbas登陸；蘇軍經Ardabil、Meshgin Shahr、Tabriz向Zanjan、Qazvin推進。英蘇兩軍有戰略與後勤協調，卻沒有把兩支部隊混成同一個師級指揮體系，而是維持英方偏西南方、蘇方偏北方的兩條主要進攻軸。
countriesEn: This campaign was launched by Britain and the Soviet Union against the Empire of Iran on 25 August 1941 and passed through its main military phase when Reza Shah abdicated on 16 September. The British side was not composed of English troops alone: the British Middle East Command directed operations, with the British 4th Indian Division and 18th Infantry Brigade forming the ground effort, supported by the Royal Air Force, the Royal Navy, and transport, logistics, and engineer units brought from India and Iraq. The Soviet side was directed by the Transcaucasus Military District. Its main force was the Red Army 39th Army Corps, supported by the Caspian Flotilla and aviation, with its ground columns crossing from southern Azerbaijan SSR into northern Iran. Iran opposed the invasion with the Imperial Iranian Army, placing several divisional formations along the northwestern and northern frontiers while units directly under the capital defended Tehran. British forces entered from Iraq around Khanaqin and Qasr-e Shirin, while the 18th Brigade landed at Bandar Abbas on the Persian Gulf. Soviet troops advanced through Ardabil, Meshgin Shahr, and Tabriz toward Zanjan and Qazvin. The British and Soviet armies coordinated strategically and logistically, but they did not merge into a single divisional command; they retained separate axes, with the British operating mainly to the southwest and the Soviets to the north.
people: 禮薩・沙是伊朗國君，也是拒絕英蘇最後通牒、動員軍隊抵抗入侵的核心決策者；他的拖延最初使英蘇有機會分別部署，但當德黑蘭與主要交通線相繼受到威脅時，他於9月16日簽署退位文件，把王位交給王儲穆罕默德・禮薩・巴列維。伊朗軍隊總參謀長兼國防部長巴赫拉姆・阿爾法（Bahram Arfa）負責統率分散於西北、北部及首都地區的部隊；阿里・曼蘇爾（Ali Mansur）在1941年8月出任首相，參與了應戰及外交接觸。英方由中東總司令克勞德・艾奇萊克（Claude Auchinleck）負責戰區全局，英軍第4印度師師長愛德華・格里格（Edward Grigg）率領主力從伊拉克越境，第18步兵旅則執行波斯灣登陸與東側推進。蘇軍第39軍由尼古拉・瓦圖京（Nikolai Vatutin）實際指揮，外高加索軍區則由伊凡・切爾尼赫（Ivan Chernykh）統籌，裏海艦隊負責海上側翼。各級前線指揮官最大的差異，在於英蘇計畫預先協調，伊朗各師卻缺乏能將邊界、首都與後方連成一個共同行動的統一指揮機制。
peopleEn: Reza Shah was the ruler of Iran and the central decision-maker who rejected the Anglo-Soviet ultimatum and mobilized the army to resist the invasion. His delay initially allowed Britain and the Soviet Union to complete their separate deployments, but once Tehran and the principal transport corridors came under threat, he signed an abdication on 16 September and transferred the throne to his son, Crown Prince Mohammad Reza Pahlavi. General Bahram Arfa, Iran's chief of staff and minister of war, commanded the formations dispersed across the northwest, the north, and the capital. Ali Mansur became prime minister in August 1941 and participated in both the military response and diplomatic contacts. On the British side, Commander-in-Chief Middle East Claude Auchinleck directed the theater, Major General Edward Grigg led the 4th Indian Division across the Iraqi frontier, and the 18th Infantry Brigade carried out the Persian Gulf landing and advance along the eastern side of the country. The Soviet 39th Army Corps was operationally commanded by Nikolai Vatutin, while Ivan Chernykh directed the Transcaucasus Military District and the Caspian Flotilla covered the maritime flank. The decisive difference among the commanders was that the British and Soviet plans were coordinated in advance, whereas the Iranian divisions lacked a unified command capable of linking the frontier, the capital, and the rear into a single operation.
kits: 英印步兵的標準槍械包括Lee-Enfield No.4式及SMLE Mk III*步槍，機槍有Bren Mk I輕機槍與Vickers中型機槍；反坦克武器包括2-pounder與6-pounder火炮，野戰及師級火砲包括15-pounder和25-pounder field gun。英軍裝甲與偵察可使用Light Tank Mk III、A9 Cruiser Mk I及Universal Carrier，皇家空軍在伊拉克與波斯灣一線可投入Gloster Gladiator和Westland Lysander執行偵察、護衛及近距支援。蘇軍步兵使用Mosin-Nagant Model 1891/30步槍、DP-27輕機槍及SVT-38步槍，裝甲包括T-34 1940年型與T-40 1940年型，火炮則有2A25型45公厘反坦克炮、M1902/30型76公厘野戰炮及軍團制炮兵。伊朗軍隊的裝備體系較雜，常見英系SMLE Mk III*、Mauser Model 98k步槍、Maxim M1910機槍、Bofors m/37 75公厘野戰炮及Schneider-Creusot 75公厘炮，並有從波蘭取得的7TP輕戰車及Gloster Gladiator戰鬥機。上述型號在1941年以前均已列裝，但型號存在並不代表每個旅都配備了全部項目。實戰補給又受到彈藥口徑限制：英印軍主要使用.303口徑，蘇軍使用7.62×54公厘，伊朗軍則同時有7.92公厘與.303口徑步槍彈藥，三套供應系統不能直接互換。
kitsEn: Standard weapons of the British and Indian infantry included the Lee-Enfield No.4 and SMLE Mk III* rifles, with the Bren Mk I light machine gun and Vickers medium machine gun. Anti-tank equipment included the 2-pounder and 6-pounder guns, while field and divisional artillery included the 15-pounder and 25-pounder field guns. British armor and reconnaissance units could use the Light Tank Mk III, A9 Cruiser Mk I, and Universal Carrier, and the Royal Air Force could commit the Gloster Gladiator and Westland Lysander to reconnaissance, protection, and close support along the Iraqi and Persian Gulf routes. Soviet infantry used the Mosin-Nagant Model 1891/30 rifle, DP-27 light machine gun, and SVT-38 rifle. Their armor included the T-34 Model 1940 and T-40 Model 1940, while their artillery included the 2A25 45 mm anti-tank gun, M1902/30 76 mm field gun, and corps artillery. The Iranian equipment system was more mixed, incorporating British SMLE Mk III* rifles, Mauser Model 98k rifles, Maxim M1910 machine guns, Bofors m/37 75 mm field guns, Schneider-Creusot 75 mm guns, Polish-built 7TP light tanks, and Gloster Gladiator fighters. All of these types had entered service before 1941, but their presence in the theater did not mean that every brigade possessed every item. Logistics were further constrained by ammunition calibers: the British and Indian forces mainly used .303 ammunition, the Soviet Army used 7.62×54 mm, and Iranian troops fielded both 7.92 mm and .303 rifle ammunition. The three supply systems could not be used interchangeably.
tactics: 英軍的主要戰法是沿現成公路進行兩翼與縱深推進，而非把全部兵力壓在同一條道路上。第4印度師由伊拉克越境後，以縱隊分別指向Kermanshah、Hamadan與德黑蘭方向，另一支則經Dezful、Ahvaz控制通往Abadan的西南通道；裝甲先遣車、Universal Carrier與步兵縱隊協同搜索道路和側翼，工兵處理橋梁、渡口及受阻路段，後方保留砲兵、補充點與維修單位。第18步兵旅由海上進入Bandar Abbas，沿東側交通線向Shiraz與Isfahan方向推進，控制港口及通往內陸的側翼。皇家空軍掩護運動中的縱隊，皇家海軍負責登陸、海上交通與波斯灣沿岸支援。蘇軍第39軍從多個邊境口岸向內展開，步兵、坦克和砲兵沿Ardabil、Tabriz、Zanjan至Qazvin的縱深道路推進，裏海艦隊則沿西岸提供側翼掩護與補給。伊朗軍隊以邊境陣地、阻止線、砲兵火力及局部反擊試圖延緩推進，Dezful與Hamadan一線曾出現實質抵抗，但各師缺少一致的總攻計畫與穩定後路，縱隊被突破後即失去協同。英蘇部隊的補給同樣受山區道路限制：英方物資由伊拉克後方及印度海運線供應，蘇方由外高加索鐵路節點與裏海航路輸送。雙方的油料、輪胎、車輛維修、普通炸藥、反坦克彈及傷員後送都必須沿狹窄道路緩慢前送，現有史料沒有留下可可靠核對的各期總噸位。
tacticsEn: British operations relied on movement along existing roads along two separate axes rather than concentrating every formation on one route. After crossing from Iraq, the 4th Indian Division formed columns pointing toward Kermanshah, Hamadan, and Tehran, while another force moved through Dezful and Ahvaz toward the southwest route to Abadan. Armored reconnaissance vehicles, Universal Carriers, and infantry columns searched the roads and flanks, engineers dealt with bridges, fords, and obstructed sections, and artillery, supply points, and maintenance units remained behind the leading formations. The 18th Infantry Brigade entered by sea at Bandar Abbas and advanced along the eastern transport routes toward Shiraz and Isfahan, securing the port and the flank of the inland approaches. The Royal Air Force covered columns on the move, while the Royal Navy supported the landing, maritime communications, and Persian Gulf littoral. The Soviet 39th Army Corps expanded inward through several border crossings, with infantry, tanks, and artillery advancing along the roads from Ardabil through Tabriz, Zanjan, and Qazvin. The Caspian Flotilla covered the western shore and supported supply movement. Iranian forces attempted to delay the advance with frontier positions, blocking lines, artillery fire, and local counterattacks. Substantial resistance occurred around Dezful and Hamadan, but the divisions lacked a coherent general offensive and dependable rear areas, so isolated columns lost coordination once bypassed. British and Soviet supply was also constrained by mountain roads. British matériel came through the Iraqi rear and by sea from India, while Soviet supplies moved from Transcaucasian railway nodes and through Caspian routes. Fuel, tires, vehicle maintenance, high-explosive shells, anti-tank ammunition, and evacuation of wounded personnel all had to advance slowly along narrow roads. The surviving records do not provide a reliably comparable total tonnage for each supply period.
data: 1941年8月15日，英國與蘇聯代表在莫斯科簽署共同入侵伊朗的協議；8月21日，兩國向德黑蘭提出內容相近的最後通牒，要求伊朗接受聯軍進駐，禮薩・沙拒絕後仍 命令軍隊動員。8月25日，英方行動代號Countenance展開：第4印度師由伊拉克越過Khanaqin、Qasr-e Shirin一帶的邊界，第39軍亦由亞塞拜然北部越境，兩面先頭部隊分別沿通往Kermanshah、Hamadan與Tabriz的公路展開。8月27日，第18步兵旅由海上在Bandar Abbas登陸，建立東側灘頭，Royal Navy控制近岸航路；第4印度師則在伊拉克境內完成補給後越境，先頭部隊向Dezful、Ahvaz及Abadan方向推進。八月底至九月初，伊朗邊防與地方部隊在Dezful、Hamadan及通往Qazvin的道路上進行抵抗，英軍因此必須部署側翼、砲兵及工兵，不能始終保持單純的行軍速度；蘇軍則由Ardabil向Tabriz推進，在控制Zanjan後續向Qazvin行軍。9月上旬，另一支英軍縱隊越過Hamadan方向，蘇軍也已打通Zanjan至Qazvin的縱深道路。9月9日，英軍先頭部隊進入德黑蘭；9月13日，蘇軍進入德黑蘭及北郊的主要交通地帶，兩支部隊由此形成對首都與中央公路的實際控制。9月16日，禮薩・沙在德黑蘭議會簽署退位文件，穆罕默德・禮薩・巴列維於同日宣誓即位，主要戰鬥至此停止；其餘伊朗部隊則在之後數週陸續被解除武裝或解散。現存各方戰報沒有提供口徑一致、可以交叉核驗的完整傷亡總數，因此本文不列出任何精確總數，而只把零散戰報中的戰鬥損失、疾病減員與車輛故障分開看待。
dataEn: On 15 August 1941, British and Soviet representatives signed the agreement in Moscow for their joint invasion of Iran. On 21 August, the two governments presented the Tehran government with closely aligned ultimatums demanding acceptance of foreign troops; Reza Shah rejected them but still ordered mobilization. On 25 August, the British operation Countenance began. The 4th Indian Division crossed the frontier around Khanaqin and Qasr-e Shirin, while the Soviet 39th Army Corps entered from northern Azerbaijan, and the leading formations of both armies expanded along the roads toward Kermanshah, Hamadan, and Tabriz. On 27 August, the 18th Infantry Brigade landed by sea at Bandar Abbas and established an eastern bridgehead while the Royal Navy controlled coastal navigation. The 4th Indian Division completed its preparations in Iraq before crossing, with its leading troops advancing toward Dezful, Ahvaz, and Abadan. From late August to early September, Iranian frontier and local formations resisted along Dezful, Hamadan, and the roads to Qazvin. The British therefore had to deploy flank protection, artillery, and engineers instead of maintaining a simple marching pace, while the Soviets advanced from Ardabil toward Tabriz and then down the road from Zanjan. In early September, another British column passed in the Hamadan direction, and Soviet troops had opened the inland route from Zanjan toward Qazvin. British leading elements entered Tehran on 9 September, and Soviet troops entered Tehran and the principal northern approaches on 13 September, placing the capital and central highway under effective control. On 16 September, Reza Shah signed his abdication in the Tehran parliament, and Crown Prince Mohammad Reza Pahlavi took the oath the same day. The main fighting then ceased, while other Iranian units were disarmed or disbanded during the following weeks. The surviving reports do not provide a consistent, cross-verifiable total for all casualties, so this account gives no exact aggregate; it distinguishes combat losses recorded in scattered reports from reductions caused by sickness and vehicle failures.
cause: 直接背景是1941年6月22日德國進攻蘇聯。巴巴羅莎行動迅速削弱蘇聯西線，蘇聯擔心德軍往高加索與裏海方向推進，更顧慮 Baku 油田、北高加索及伊朗北部交通線落入德國控制，因此需要先鞏固亞塞拜然和波斯的北翼。英國則從印度、伊拉克與波斯灣安全考慮出發：Abadan 煉油廠及英伊石油公司在伊朗的資產是帝國戰區的重要支柱，而伊朗與德國保持軍事、經貿及技術合作，讓倫敦懷疑德國將把伊朗變成支援中東與蘇聯戰事的基地。伊朗當時宣稱中立，禮薩・沙既不願讓英國單獨控制本國，也不願接受蘇聯由北方深入，因此拒絕了兩國提出的通軍條件。英國擔心單獨入侵會引起反覆交戰，蘇聯則不希望英國趁機占領整個北部，8月15日的協議因而成為共同出兵、各自負責不同戰區的基礎。8月21日最後通牒失敗後，英蘇才依既定計畫同時越境。
causeEn: The immediate background was Germany's invasion of the Soviet Union on 22 June 1941. Operation Barbarossa rapidly weakened the Soviet western front, and Moscow feared a German drive toward the Caucasus and Caspian region. The Baku oilfields, the North Caucasus, and Iran's northern communications were therefore regarded as areas that had to be secured before Germany could use them. Britain approached the problem from the security of India, Iraq, and the Persian Gulf. The Abadan refinery and the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company's interests in Iran were important assets for the imperial war effort, while Iran's military, commercial, and technical relations with Germany raised London's concern that the country might be turned into a base supporting operations in the Middle East and against the Soviet Union. Iran was then officially neutral. Reza Shah was unwilling to allow Britain to control the country alone, but equally resisted Soviet penetration from the north, so he rejected the terms for the entry of foreign troops. Britain feared that unilateral invasion would produce repeated fighting, while the Soviet Union did not want the British to occupy all of northern Iran. The agreement of 15 August consequently became the basis for a joint invasion in which each power would be responsible for a different theater. After the ultimatum of 21 August failed, British and Soviet forces crossed the frontier under their existing plans.
impact: 這次行動最直接的戰略影響，是伊朗不再能保持原有的中立位置。英軍控制Abadan煉油區、Bandar Abbas港及通往伊拉克的西路，蘇軍則占據北部山區並接近通往Baku的產油區，伊朗北部與裏海沿岸的軍事縱深落入蘇方控制。與此同時，英國利用波斯中部道路把伊拉克與蘇聯連接起來，形成經Tabriz、Tehran、Kermanshah通往Baghdad的北南補給走廊；大批英美物資由波斯灣、伊拉克及中東其他基地運入，經伊朗再送往蘇聯戰區。這條路線需要不斷處理車隊優先次序、燃料、輪胎、橋梁維修及前進側衛，但確實改變了英蘇在1941年後的供應格局。德國在伊朗原有的軍事顧問及航空活動失去立足點，禮薩・沙也於退位後流亡，伊朗國防軍被解除武裝並限制重建，穆罕默德・禮薩即位後的王位得以延續，但英蘇駐軍與政治影響使君主制的自主性受到長期限制。蘇聯利用北方占據區發展其在亞塞拜然的影響，並在後續石油協議中取得新的經濟安排；英國則保障Abadan與南部石油利益，同時獲得從波斯灣進入伊朗的軍事據點。
impactEn: The most immediate strategic effect was that Iran could no longer retain its previous position of neutrality. British forces secured the Abadan oil district, Bandar Abbas harbor, and the western route toward Iraq, while Soviet troops occupied the northern highlands and reached the approaches to the Baku oil-producing region. Iran's northern flank and Caspian littoral consequently came under Soviet military control. At the same time, Britain used the roads through central Persia to connect Iraq and the Soviet Union, creating a north-south supply corridor running through Tabriz, Tehran, and Kermanshah toward Baghdad. Supplies from the Persian Gulf, Iraq, and other Middle Eastern bases passed through Iran toward the Soviet front. The route required constant management of convoy priorities, fuel, tires, bridge repair, and advance protection, but it materially changed the British and Soviet supply system after 1941. Germany's former military advisers and aviation activities in Iran lost their base. Reza Shah went into exile after his abdication, the Iranian armed forces were disarmed and restricted in reconstruction, and Mohammad Reza's monarchy survived while British and Soviet troops constrained the sovereign authority of the state over the long term. The Soviet Union used its northern occupied zone to expand its influence in Azerbaijan and later obtained new economic arrangements through oil agreements. Britain protected Abadan and the southern petroleum interests while gaining military access to Iran from the Persian Gulf.
result: 作戰結果是英蘇聯軍完成了伊朗中部、北部與德黑蘭的軍事控制，但過程並非一場雙方集中兵力進行的單一會戰。英軍由西南方切斷Dezful、Ahvaz、Abadan與首都之間的道路，第18旅則封住Bandar Abbas及東部內陸通道；蘇軍控制Tabriz、Zanjan、Qazvin等北部城鎮和通往裏海油田區的接近路線，使伊朗軍隊失去繼續以師級單位組織抵抗的條件。禮薩・沙於9月16日退位後，英蘇接受穆罕默德・禮薩・巴列維為新國君，伊朗陸軍隨後被解散或整編，外國部隊則繼續控制關鍵道路、港口和油田區。9月16日只是英蘇入侵的主要軍事階段結束，而不是占領的終止；英軍依戰時安排在1946年3月撤離伊朗，蘇軍於1946年5月完成撤離。戰役留下的實質結果，是伊朗王位在更受英蘇影響的條件下延續、原有的德國軍事影響被清除、Abadan與北部石油利益分別受到英蘇保護，以及一條貫穿伊朗的英蘇補給道路被固定下來。
resultEn: The outcome was that the British and Soviet forces gained military control of central, northern, and Tehran Persia, although the campaign was not a single set-piece battle in which both sides concentrated their forces. British columns from the southwest cut the roads between Dezful, Ahvaz, Abadan, and the capital, while the 18th Brigade closed the Bandar Abbas and eastern inland approaches. Soviet troops controlled northern cities including Tabriz, Zanjan, and Qazvin, as well as the approaches to the Caspian oil district, depriving the Iranian army of the conditions required to continue organizing resistance at divisional level. After Reza Shah abdicated on 16 September, Britain and the Soviet Union accepted Mohammad Reza Pahlavi as the new ruler. The Iranian army was subsequently dissolved or reorganized, while foreign troops continued to control key roads, ports, and oil districts. The sixteenth of September marked the end of the main military phase of the invasion, not the end of the occupation. British forces withdrew from Iran in March 1946 under the wartime arrangements, and Soviet forces completed their withdrawal in May 1946. The practical result was the continuation of the Iranian monarchy under stronger British and Soviet influence, the removal of the former German military presence, the protection of Abadan and the northern petroleum interests by the occupying powers, and the establishment of a permanent British-Soviet supply route across Iran.
